column1: # every .got cell of the relocated A files: the symbol the role GOT word at the role value serves, and the symbol headamp's GOT word at the written value serves (role and headamp .got are slot-for-slot equal by symbol: 427 slots, headamp = role + 0x1b40)

# selection is BOTH ways: a row is taken when the role value lies in role's .got OR the headamp value lies in headamp's .got (headamp has no .got.plt; .got 0x9c310 + 0xd58). The converse direction alone gives the same 211 rows, all right. The patched and unit-shaped files (AE37, AE23, AB1w, AE34, AF0l, ACej), which have no line-paired role counterpart, hold 54 further numerals inside headamp's .got: every one is the start of a real slot, read from headamp's bytes.
